findings.message: 10 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "새 기능 — fx 조합 놀이터와 효과 등록 API" (pill) above "한국어 화면을 위한 UI 개발 키트"; "CSS 클래스" above "1,348"; "디자인 토큰" above "636"; "catui.js 모듈" above "21"; "템플릿" above "120종"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace, monospace — e.g. "v2.0.0", "admin.catui.dev", "catui.js 2.0.0", "모듈 21 · 의존성 0"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 3 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "매출", "주문", "전환율").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✓
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section.doc-rhero.doc-dark → linear-gradient(color(srgb 0.0875294 0.126431 0.165333) 72%, rgb(247, 248, 250) 72%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 2 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 44 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.doc-install → rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px 0px | div.doc-hx-window.doc-rhero-shot → color(srgb 0.14902 0.72549 0.603922 / 0.45) 0px -10px 80px -10px | div.Catui_card → rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.03) 0px 1px 0px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 5 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.Catui_site-header.doc-top 1440px | div.doc-hx-window.doc-rhero-shot 760px | div.doc-win-bar 758px | div.doc-win-foot 758px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 43 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Inter, ui-monospace, monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 46 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 48px (3.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: The margins differ: 41px on the left, 61px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 17px from the left edge but only to 37px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
